name: argus-desktop-tauri
description: Argus desktop host for macOS and Windows
author: lbx154

scripts.build:debug: npm run prepare:backend && tauri build --debug --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles nsis
scripts.test:rust: cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test core_tests
scripts.test: npm run ui:typecheck && npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust
scripts.dist: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-release.ps1
